title: True Detective: A Deep Abductive Reasoning Benchmark Undoable for GPT-3 and Challenging for GPT-4
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for abductive reasoning using detective puzzles. It evaluates the logical reasoning capabilities of LLMs, not their understanding or embodiment of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks. While the content of detective stories might involve ethical dilemmas, the benchmark's purpose is not to assess these aspects of the LLM.
